ranking.note: Raised to P1: fixes a reorg-time stale-query bug and a reindex startup race, removes the cs_main dependency the category explicitly values, and is the stated prerequisite for out-of-process indexes (#10102) and shared sync with wallet rescan (#15719).
Moved up from position 7: data integrity ranks first in this category, and this is the broadest fix for corrupt index/db reads being masked as missing keys.

inconsistencies: #34132 and #36789 address the same underlying problem: txindex/db read failures surfacing as 'transaction not found' instead of an error. #34132 is the broader treatment (fatal errors across dbwrapper, txindex consistency and block-file reads); #36789 is a targeted FindTx iterator-status check following merged #35728. Review #34132 first and decide scope, then check whether #36789 is subsumed or still needed as the narrow fix.

Chain: #34489 (batched index writes, depends on merged #34897) extracts the foundation work for #26966 (parallel index sync); the author states they proceed alongside. Review #34489 before #26966 even though #26966 reports the larger headline speedup.

#24230 and #35474 both decouple indexes from node-global state. #24230 is the deeper change (removes cs_main from the sync/notification path, moves indexes behind interfaces); #35474 only moves ownership of index instances into NodeContext. Settling #24230's direction first avoids rework in #35474.

#36480 (txospenderindex compact keys) reuses the scheme from txindex #35531 and claims to prepare txospenderindex for pruned mode; #36002 does the pruned-mode work for txindex. Their shared block-sequence helpers should be reviewed with an eye to one common abstraction.
result.notes: Only one P1: #24230 is the single PR that combines a correctness fix with removal of a shared-lock dependency and unblocks several other efforts. The P2 band is wide and deliberately ordered by the category's own precedence — data integrity, then user-facing index capability, then sync speed and disk use. The two P3s are pure encapsulation/housekeeping with no effect on index answers.
